body:
I'll take this one. Reproduced on main 865df247 with a real `magpie serve` in a sandbox: a middleware with onProvider on, a text-only model, and requests that each send four new images. The gateway exits with `fatal error: concurrent map read and map write` (or `concurrent map writes`) after 9 to 19 requests, same InternGoString frame as your trace.

The descriptions are asked through serve on a context made from the agent's request, so they carry its middleware run, and the four goroutines call onProvider on that one runtime together. The web searches magpie makes for a model that can't search do the same (two searches in a round crash it too). Patch in a few hours.

Patch: https://github.com/JoeyWu-tech/magpie/tree/fix/3695-side-requests

One commit on origin/main 865df247 (applies as is on 2beed3b0), `git format-patch --no-signature --full-index --stdout 865df247..6ac849a4 | sha256sum` is `66f48ce62425979e19fe1fd5c0b5ea8d2d58cd76c87818d195e81e297a311420`.

The image descriptions and web searches magpie makes for an agent's request now go without that request's middleware (`ownAsk` takes the request's Tried off their context), like titles and the classifier already do. The agent's own tries still run onProvider once each. I went with this over the lock (or one ask at a time, or a Run per ask) you suggested: those keep the gateway up, but still run the agent's middleware on magpie's own asks, and the hook's ctx (protocol, model, stream) is the agent's while a description is a Chat body and a search an Anthropic one.

One new test per path, both red on main's code. Without -race, main's vision.go died in all three -count=40 runs, twice of the same `concurrent map read and map write` in InternGoString as your trace. A real `magpie serve` built at 865df247 died this time on the 7th request in one run (that same error, under Run.Tried) and on the 8th in another (`concurrent map writes`), four new images each. With the patch it answered 200 of 200, twice.

Not tried on macOS or with your middleware. The report doesn't say which one it is, so if you can share it I'll run it too.

已在 v0.1.1701 修复（430e3050d），补丁来自 coffemon（@JoeyWu-tech），保留了原作者。

magpie 自己发起的图片描述和搜索（视觉替身、搜索替身）不再带着 agent 请求上的 middleware 记录，所以不会再在同一个 moejs Realm 上并发跑 agent 的 middleware，也就不会再出现 `concurrent map read and map write` 崩溃。

验证（macOS arm64，go1.26.8）：
- 新测试 TestImagesDescribedWithoutTheAgentsMiddleware / TestSearchesWithoutTheAgentsMiddleware 在 `-race -count=10` 下通过；
- 换回 main 的 vision.go / search.go，两个测试都变红，-race 报 34 处 DATA RACE；不加 -race 跑 `-count=40` 时进程直接 `fatal error: concurrent map writes`，和报告一致；
- internal/gateway 全包通过，gofmt、linux/windows vet 通过。

没试：真实 magpie serve 下多图并发描述。请升级后确认一下，问题还在的话在这里回复。
